The highlighted 20 are missed positives. Correct cases out of the relevant group Ratio | Rate Precision: $\frac{80}{90}$ | 88.89% Recall: $\frac{80}{100}$ | 80% Specificity: $\frac{90}{100}$ | 90% Rate: highlighted column Precision uses predicted positives; recall uses actual positives; specificity uses actual negatives. Percentages are rounded. Precision asks whether positive predictions were right. Recall asks how many positives were found. Specificity asks about negatives.
